description: The product of the second divergence, built rather than described: a concept stated in enough mechanism that someone else could evaluate it. tradeoffs and open_questions are required — a concept presented without either reads as settled, and the delivery seat would verify it against criteria it has no way to know were contested.

description.description: What it is, in the audience's register.

mechanism.description: How it works, step by step. The part that distinguishes a concept from a wish.

addresses.description: Which success criteria from the definition this concept answers, named individually.

tradeoffs.description: What this concept gives up, and what it buys with it.

open_questions.description: What remains unresolved in the concept as built.
